name: uniswap-v4-subgraph
description: Uniswap V4 subgraph restricted to Seer prediction-market pools (pools whose currencies include a Seer outcome token) with PositionManager positions. Deploy: goldsky login && yarn deploy-goldsky-<network>

scripts.deploy-goldsky-base: yarn generate-subgraph base && yarn build && goldsky subgraph deploy seer-v4-pools-base/1.1.0 --path .
scripts.deploy-goldsky-optimism: yarn generate-subgraph optimism && yarn build && goldsky subgraph deploy seer-v4-pools-optimism/1.1.0 --path .
scripts.deploy-goldsky-mainnet: yarn generate-subgraph mainnet && yarn build && goldsky subgraph deploy seer-v4-pools-mainnet/1.1.0 --path .
